newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Lebed offends Argentina with "coup" comment.
newsitem.headline: Lebed offends Argentina with "coup" comment.

text.p: The Argentine government summoned a Russian diplomat on Thursday to lodge a protest over a reported comment by Russian security chief Alexander Lebed that there was no risk of a military coup because "we are not Argentina."
An Argentine Foreign Ministry spokesman quoted a news report saying Lebed, asked if there was any risk of a military coup against President Boris Yeltsin's government, answered:
"There is no tradition of military coups here. We are not Argentina, thank God."

The Russian commercial attache in Buenos Aires, Yuri Korchaguin, was called to the ministry to meet its director of Eastern European affairs, Vicente Espeche Gil, "to let him know of the Argentine government's displeasure."

Argentina's history has been plagued with bloody military coups since the 1930s. The last military regime ended in 1983 and since then Argentina has held three democratic elections, the last two won by Peronist President Carlos Menem.
